## Anas v5.2.6

- 附件的删除与后续携带按钮改为悬停显示。
- 项目内技能和工具默认收起并显示数量；多个源文件夹的技能按源分组，支持打开对应 skills 总目录，统一按钮与列表间距。
- 修复 Windows 上长归档路径导致的原图预览失败，保留流式读取与取消能力。

- Show attachment remove and keep-in-conversation controls on hover.
- Collapse project skills and tools by default with item counts; group skills by source folder, add buttons to open each skills directory, and standardize spacing.
- Fix original-image previews for long archive paths on Windows while preserving streaming and cancellation.
